avis.texte: Unfortunately dislike the scent very much, both while applying and afterwards.

I love Goop products, but this is not my favorite. The scent is similar to cilantro. The texture may be exfoliating to the skin, but when rinsed off, it feels like a film is left on your skin. I need to wash my face again to remove that.
Liking the jelly cleanser, but would like a better fragrance.

avis.titre: Mild everyday exfoliation for an everyday glow.
avis.texte: Use this mild exfoliation every day. I learned from GP that the exfoliation is the key for the glowing skin. It is mild on my sensitive skin suitable for every day usage, love the texture and the smell.
Love this cleanser! Has a little exfoliation too. You won't be disappointed
This is the best exfoliator. Gentle and effective, I keep it in the shower and use it regularly. Causes no irritation to my sensative skin.
This cleanser is gentle enough to use morning and night! My face is so clean and soft after. Love it!!!!
Love how clean this makes my face feel so clean but not stripped. I ended up purchasing more so that I have one in my travel bag, my sink, and one in my shower.
This face wash is ok, it doesn't lather and the beads are pretty large. I wouldn't buy it again.
My face actually brightened after the first use. Gentle and effective.
I could use this product everyday. It feels so good and leaves my skin clean but not dry.

avis.titre: Prefer the detoxifying cleaner to this one
avis.texte: I am an avid user of goop products. But I don't prefer this cleanser. I like the new detoxifying cleaner that just came out much better.

I use this scrub midweek (between my glow pad applications). It helps with skin turnover, but has not damaged my skin with little micro abrasions like some other scrubs. I also use it on my legs before shaving. Excellent!
Ahhh, first the scent. Just unbelievably yummy and calming. Cleans my face so well but does not strip my face dry. I would absolutely by again.
Amazing cleanser! New favorite! Smells amazing! Will repurchase!
I have buy another one; I go through it so quickly, 2x/day. A very deep cleanse, getting at bumps and fine lines, with such a lovely feel and fragrance without drying.
Wonderful smell. Didn't break out my typically sensitive skin.
Actually fun to use. You feel extra clean due to the scrubbing beads.
Sorry - fine but nothing special. Can't see any difference from similar products available at the corner drugstore.
Gentle but effective. When used a few days in a row it did cause a rosacea flare which was easily fixed by reducing to once or twice a week.
Great exfoliant. Skin is truly as clean as it can get. Soft too

I was using lancer for years and was still feeling I looked a little dull so gave this a try…I mean GP has amazing skin so why not. I love it so much. I try to only use it 1x a day since exfoliates. After a week I saw improvements and was getting compliments. I'm a basic sunscreen with tint, blush and mascara gal and I truly love how my face looks at this time. I've been using it now for 3 months and this is on my subscription. I enjoy the smell and the feel, have no prob with either. I am 45 (46 in one month), sensitive, acne prone, very dry skin.
Outstanding product! It's effective yet gentle enough for me to use everyday.

I love this exfoliating cleanser. My skin already felt softer and smoother after the very first use! I'm only using this and Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel right now, but I'm already seeing the difference on my skin after 2 weeks! When I go through my currently skin care, I'm going to change to these Goop products! Can't wait to see more changes when I start to use more Goop product! Totally loving everything I try!
This is the best 2 in 1! Fantastic scrub and cleanse that leaves your skin glowing!
I absolutely love this cleanser. It takes the day off but is gentle at the same time. It's also a great way to prep my face for serums and Goop Genes All In One Nourishing Face Cream.
Great cleanser that mildly exfoliates the skin and has a fresh scent.

avis.titre: Not worth the money for me.
avis.texte: This does not exfoliate as well as other products I have tried. It's ok but not worth the money for me.
Love this stuff. It's a really good cleanser and gentle for everyday use. No more dry flaky skin.

I like it. Gently exfoliating. I use it AM and PM. I used to exfoliate with a silicone facial "brush" 3x a week and have realized it wasn't enough. Since I use the 3x Retinol daily (except for the night I use the glycolic peel pad), I think this cleanser really helps to remove the dead skin cells.

avis.titre: Perfect exfoliator to use every day
avis.texte: It's gentle enough to use every morning but powerful enough to leave my face feeling fresh and soft.
Since I began using this cleanser, my face seems brighter and I have fewer dry patches

This is my daily face wash. Like all Goop products, it has a pleasant scent without being overly perfumed. I appreciate the smoothness of the exfoliating beads, which polish the skin rather than rougher alternatives that can cause micro tears. After rinsing, my face and neck feel thoroughly cleansed without feeling stripped. Additionally, as a bonus, I use what remains on the back of my hands.

It smells so fresh and is just exactly the right consistency to lightly exfoliate my face, neck chest and forearms. It leaves me feeling super clean and refreshed. I'm 71 and have given this product to my 3 grown daughters and my sister in law more than once. It's a real skin care staple for me.
This product really cleans my skin. Goop is always mad with great ingredients. I have many items now for face, body & hair & all are fantastic
The light exfoliation doesn't irritate my skin but makes it glow!
